SIGNED MEMORANDUM M-77

Date: Mon 12 Oct 2026, 16:00 UTC
Signed: A. Ferreira-Zhang, Deputy Chief Operating Officer
Signed: R. Ghalib, Head of Portfolio Recovery
Distribution: Group Legal; Collections Operations; Systems
In force from: Tue 13 Oct 2026, 00:00 UTC. Supersedes the clauses named below of the O&M Policy
(HL-OM-2026) with immediate effect. Clauses not named below are untouched.

M-1  (supersedes clause 4.1 of the Policy, in common identity scheme)
     Notwithstanding clause 4.1, the identity scheme shall be conducted in this order:
     first `konto_code`, then `geburtsdatum`, then `postleitzahl`. The request wording and the
     technical formats fixed by clause 4.2 are unaffected (q.v. clause 4.2 continues to apply).

M-2  (supersedes clause 4.3 of the Policy)
     The global ceiling of unsuccessful answers is lowered to four (4), in place of three (3).
     The remaining-slot field returned by the identity facility continues to govern the count;
     the Operations Division shall make no private tally.

M-3  (supersedes clause 3.1 of the Policy, in part)
     Telephone contact is available on the business day following the call only, between 09:00
     and 18:00 inclusive, always later than the call time.

M-4  (supersedes clause 7.1 of the Policy, respect of the late band)
     For the late band (30-60 days past) the ultimate date shall be the twentieth (20th) day of
     the calendar month following the call, shifted to the next business day wherever needed
     (see clause 5.2 for the definition of business day). The band's two-attempt schedule in
     clause 7.2 is unchanged.
